papers.title: Visions for hydrogen-based materials for energy applications
papers.abstract_en: The world’s dependence on fossil fuels necessitates rapid advancement of clean storage and renewable energy technologies. There is abundance of renewable energy in the form of solar irradiance and wind, and the most commonly used energy carrier for these sources is electricity using batteries. Hydrogen is a viable energy carrier because of its diverse chemistry and capacity to form a wide range of bonds and interactions with most other elements. Hydrogen-based materials encompass a great variety of compositions, structures and properties, which modern synthesis methods can further tailor towards targeted applications. Of these, sodium tetrahydridoborate (NaBH 4 ) is a candidate for long-distance transport and seasonal hydrogen storage, releasing up to 137 kg H 2 /m 3 upon reaction with water. Metallic hydrides can be used for hydrogen storage (limited to gravimetric densities of approximately 2 wt% H 2 ), used in nickel-metal hydride batteries and are also applicable to piston-free hydrogen compression to 100 MPa and higher. Reactive hydride composites may provide enhanced storage capacities suitable for mobile applications, while physisorption in inexpensive porous materials enables hydrogen storage at cryogenic temperatures. Beyond hydrogen storage, boron-based hydrides have attracted recent interest owing to very high cationic conductivity at moderate temperatures. Divalent cationic conductors, such as Mg 2+ and Ca 2+ , show particular promise as electrolytes in novel solid-state batteries. In addition, new types of hydrides with unexpectedly high hydrogen content, denoted ‘super-hydrides’, have been identified as high-temperature superconductors. Collectively, hydrogen-containing materials offer the potential of new applications across areas of energy storage and transport, conversion, and superconductivity, underscoring the role of hydrogen not merely as an energy carrier but as a foundation for the next generation of viable, decarbonised energy infrastructure. Continued research may accelerate the global transition towards clean and renewable energy systems.
papers.summary_ko: 수소화물, 보로하이드라이드 등 수소 기반 소재의 에너지 저장·변환 응용을 폭넓게 조망하는 리뷰다. 수소 저장·운송과 일부 다가 양이온(Mg2+, Ca2+) 고체전해질로서의 가능성을 다루나, 본 사이트가 다루는 리튬/소듐 전지 전극 소재와는 직접적 관련이 적다.

papers.title: Switchable nucleophile-electrophile chemistry enables functional four-electron Li-I2 batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Four-electron iodine redox chemistry offers a high theoretical specific energy of ~1324 Wh kgI −1 , yet its practical realization is fundamentally limited by the conflicting demands of rapid I 0 /I + oxidation, effective suppression of iodine shuttling, and stabilization of highly reactive I + species. Here we report a redox-active, Lewis acid/base-tunable phthalimide that resolves these constraints through a single-molecule polarity-switching mechanism. Upon electrochemical oxidation, electrophilic phthalimide δ+ strongly interacts with nucleophilic iodine and polyiodide species, concurrently suppressing polyiodide shuttling and promoting their conversion to I + . The consecutively generated phthalimide δ− acts as a nucleophilic stabilizer for the resulting I + species. This electrochemically driven polarity switching of phthalimide enables flexible four-electron Li-I 2 pouch cells that deliver ~400 mAh gI −1 capacity, a specific energy exceeding 1200 Wh kgI −1 , a high cathode-level specific energy ( ~ 883.4 Wh kg(cathode) −1 ), and stable cycling over 1000 cycles. The successful integration of these cells into wearable wireless charging and motion-sensing systems demonstrates the potential of polarity-switchable iodine chemistry for next-generation flexible energy-storage devices.
papers.summary_ko: 4전자 요오드 redox 화학을 이용한 Li-I2 전지에서, 산화 시 친전자성으로 환원 시 친핵성으로 전환되는 극성 스위칭 프탈이미드 분자를 도입해 폴리아이오다이드 셔틀링을 억제하고 반응성이 높은 I+ 종을 안정화한다. 이를 통해 높은 비에너지와 1000회 이상의 안정적 사이클 수명을 갖는 플렉시블 파우치셀을 구현했다.

papers.title: Non-halogen aqueous electrolytes for four-electron iodine conversion
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Accessing reversible four-electron iodine redox chemistry in aqueous metal–iodine batteries offers a promising route towards high-energy aqueous energy storage, but has conventionally relied on highly concentrated, corrosive halogen-containing electrolytes to stabilize reactive hypervalent iodine cations through interhalogen complexation 1–9 . Here we show a kosmotropic anion–polar anion–nucleophilic species (Nuc) electrolyte framework that harnesses anionic chemistry to coordinate the interfacial microenvironment and molecular interactions, enabling reversible four-electron iodine conversion in halogen-free aqueous electrolytes. Polar anions establish a water-deficient, anion-enriched interfacial microenvironment, whereas kosmotropic anions regulate water–Nuc interactions to increase the availability of Nuc for stabilizing hypervalent iodine cations through Nuc–I + –Nuc halogen bonds. This electrolyte framework is validated across diverse Nuc and in both aqueous Zn–I 2 and Al–I 2 batteries. Moving beyond conventional interhalogen stabilization, these findings establish a distinct electrolyte chemistry framework and represent a mechanistic shift for reversible multi-electron iodine chemistry in aqueous environments.
papers.summary_ko: 할로겐 함유 전해질 없이도 수계 Zn-I2, Al-I2 전지에서 가역적인 4전자 요오드 전환을 구현하는 코스모트로픽 음이온-극성 음이온-친핵종 기반 전해질 프레임워크를 제시한다. 리튬이나 소듐이 아닌 아연/알루미늄 기반 수계 할로겐 전지에 관한 연구다.

papers.title: Nitrogen Harmonized Fluoride Solid‐State Electrolytes With Modulus‐Mismatch‐Induced Interfacial Defects for Fast Li + Transport
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Fluoride‐based solid electrolytes possess excellent air stability, strong oxidation stability and wide electrochemical windows, however their application potential is hindered by intrinsic poor ionic conductivity. Herein, a fused‐salt‐etched nitrogen‐modulated fluoride electrolyte (LAFN) is designed to improve conductivity performance via synergistic interfacial construction and lattice coordination regulation. The chloride softened grain boundaries and constructed K(Na)Cl/LAFN heterostructures optimize solid‐solid contact, while the Young modulus mismatch between K(Na)Cl and LAFN domains generates massive lattice distortion and defect regions, which can percolate to form continuous pathways for rapid Li + diffusion. Nitrogen doping mediates the generation of self‐limiting stable Li 3 N‐LiF composite layer on Li metal, effectively inhibiting the anode side reactions. It also enables the weakening of rigid Li‐F ionic bonding with the enrichment of lithium vacancies, and the moderate Li‐N coordination balances the activation of Li + migration and structural stability. As a result, the room‐temperature ionic conductivity of LAFN is elevated to 2.04 × 10 −4 S cm −1 , delivering outstanding rate capability and long‐cycle stability in both symmetric and full cells. The LiFePO 4 ‐based solid‐state full cells retain the 81.9% capacity retention after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. When paired with conversion‐type FeF 3 , the cells deliver a high reversible capacity of 233.24 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 질소 도핑과 염 융융 에칭으로 불화물 고체전해질(LAFN)의 이온전도도와 계면 특성을 개선한 연구다. K(Na)Cl/LAFN 이종계면과 격자 변형을 통해 Li+ 전도 경로를 형성하고, Li3N-LiF 보호층으로 리튬 음극 부반응을 억제해 LiFePO4 및 FeF3 전고체 셀에서 향상된 가역용량과 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Layer Stacking Structure Governed Transition‐Metal Interlayer Migration for Reversible High‐Voltage Oxygen Redox Plateau
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Utilization of lattice oxygen redox electrochemistry is the holy grail for achieving high‐capacity layered cathodes. However, prior to this, the large voltage hysteresis must be overcome. In this work, we uncover a novel scientific nature of layered stacking structure‐governed interlayer transition‑metal migration that substantially modulates the reversibility of the high‐voltage oxygen plateau. It is discovered that a kind of ribbon superlattice can facilitate the reversible high‐voltage oxygen redox plateau in the P3‐Na 0.6 Li 0.2 Mn 0.6 Ti 0.2 O 2 with the oxygen stacking series of “ABBCCA…”, but plays no role in the P2‐Na 0.6 Li 0.2 Mn 0.6 Ti 0.2 O 2 counterpart with the oxygen stacking series of “ABBA…”. Combined with the experiments and theoretical calculations, it is unraveled that the P3 stacking framework can suppress O‐type stacking faults and in turn elevates steric hindrance to the transition metal migration and the formation of molecular oxygen, thus enabling reversible high‐voltage oxygen redox. In contrast, the P2 phase can transform into O2 phase at de‐sodiated state, which accelerates severe interlayer transition metal migration, and triggers in‐plane structural reconstruction and molecular oxygen, leading to loss of high‐voltage plateau. This finding reveals how the layer stacking structure modulates the reversible oxygen redox plateau.
papers.summary_ko: P2형과 P3형 Na0.6Li0.2Mn0.6Ti0.2O2 소듐 층상 산화물에서 산소 적층 구조가 고전압 산소 redox 플래토의 가역성을 좌우함을 규명했다. P3 구조는 산소형 적층 결함을 억제해 전이금속의 층간 이동을 막아 가역적 산소 redox를 가능케 하지만, P2 구조는 탈소듐화 시 O2상으로 전환되며 전이금속 이동과 구조 재배열이 심화되어 고전압 플래토를 상실한다.

papers.title: Hollow CoS/Co 9 S 8 Prisms With Tunable Shell Thickness for Fast and Durable Sodium Storage
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Hollow nanostructures are widely adopted for energy storage as the void space can accommodate the possible volume change during cycling, but how the shell would regulate reaction kinetics and mechanical stability remains insufficiently understood. Herein, hollow CoS/Co 9 S 8 prisms with tunable shell thickness are prepared to clarify the shell thickness‐dependent sodium storage behavior. Three samples with shell thicknesses of 95, 65, and 45 nm are obtained, and with the help of finite element analysis, CoS/Co 9 S 8 ‐65 with a shell thickness of 65 nm shows the most favorable balance between kinetic properties and structural robustness. CoS/Co 9 S 8 ‐45 with the thinnest shell promotes Na + diffusion but suffers from severe stress accumulation and structural degradation, whereas CoS/Co 9 S 8 ‐95 with the thickest shell improves mechanical stability but limits Na + diffusion and reaction activity. Benefiting from the optimized shell thickness, CoS/Co 9 S 8 ‐65 delivers exceptional sodium storage performance, achieving a high reversible capacity (638 mAh g −1 after 500 cycles at 1 A g −1 ), superior rate performance (496 mAh g −1 at 20 A g −1 ), and stable cyclic performance (2000 cycles with 488 mAh g −1 at 5 A g −1 ). In addition, the CoS/Co 9 S 8 ‐65//Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 F 3 (NVPF) full cell demonstrates favorable cycling stability, confirming its potential for practical sodium storage applications.
papers.summary_ko: 쉘 두께가 다른 중공형 CoS/Co9S8 프리즘을 제작해 소듐 저장 반응속도론과 구조 안정성 간의 관계를 분석했다. 65nm 두께 쉘에서 두 특성의 최적 균형을 이루어 우수한 가역용량, 율속 성능, 장기 사이클 안정성을 달성했으며 NVPF 양극과의 풀셀에서도 안정적 거동을 확인했다.

papers.title: Bioinspired Buffered Microenvironment Enables Highly Crystalline 3D COF Gels With Controllable Structures for Exceptional Molecular Adsorption
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Reconciling long‐range crystallinity with macroscopic network formation remains a central challenge in constructing three‐dimensional covalent organic framework (3D COF) gels. Inspired by biomineralization and tofu coagulation, we propose a synergistic buffered system with salt bridges for direct assembly of crystalline 3D COF gels via imine condensation. Ten metal salts were selected to regulate stable and buffered pH microenvironment. Comparing various salts revealed a correlation between pH microenvironment and the formation state and crystallinity of COFs. NaAc emerges as representative regulator for multiple roles: (i) forming AcO − /AcOH buffer to maintain a stable weakly acidic microenvironment and promote disorder‐to‐order transition, (ii) regulating kinetics, defect healing, and COF topology, and (iii) Na + as salt bridges stabilizing the 3D gel network. Pore topology can be switched between two crystalline phases by varying side substituents and salt addition sequence, as seen by XRD peak shift from 8.9° to 6.6°. The gels have low density (0.028–0.042 g/cm 3 ), high compressive strength, CO 2 /N 2 selectivity of 140, organic solvent uptake up to 80 times their weight, and over 90% capacity retention after 20 cycles. Overall, this work establishes a paradigm from microenvironment engineering and ion selection to topology regulation and adsorption, providing a blueprint for functional 3D COF gels.
papers.summary_ko: 생체모방 완충 미세환경과 염다리(salt bridge) 개념을 이용해 결정성이 높은 3차원 공유결합유기골격체(COF) 젤을 합성한 연구다. 기체 선택적 흡착과 유기용매 흡수 성능을 구현했으나 전지 전극 소재와는 직접적 관련이 없다.

papers.title: Constructing Low‐Friction Ion Transport Pathways in Crosslinked Polymer Electrolyte for Practical Quasi‐Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Quasi‐solid‐state polymer electrolytes are promising candidates for lithium metal batteries (LMBs) with high energy density, but still suffer from sacrificed ionic conductivity caused by electrolyte solidification. Here, by tuning monomer structures with different Li + ‐affinity, we investigate the decisive role of the segmental solvation ability of the polymer matrix in cation transport. Owing to the overly strong affinity for cations, conventional ether segments significantly decrease the Li + relaxation rate, and the resulting “sticky” polymer chains impede Li + migration. In contrast, the weakly coordinating segments such as fluorinated ether could effectively minimize coupling with Li + ions, thereby constructing “low‐friction” cation transport pathways in crosslinked polymer electrolytes, as reflected by the nearly unchanged Li + relaxation kinetics and high ionic conductivity. Therefore, the industrial Li metal pouch cells achieve excellent comprehensive electrochemical performance under harsh lean‐electrolyte conditions, with electrolyte dosage even as low as 1.3 g Ah −1 . The 2 Ah NCM811/Li cell exhibits an extended lifespan beyond 520 cycles and maintains stable operation across a wide temperature range from −50°C to +90°C. The 8.7 Ah NCM955/Li cell delivers 550 Wh kg −1 energy density and demonstrates impressive cycling stability over 260 cycles. This work could inspire fundamental understanding and further development toward practical LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 가교형 고분자 전해질에서 단량체의 Li+ 친화도를 조절해 양이온 수송의 '마찰'을 낮추는 전략을 제시한다. 배위력이 약한 불화에테르 세그먼트를 도입해 Li+ 이동 속도를 높였고, 저전해질량 조건에서도 NCM811/Li 및 NCM955/Li 파우치셀이 넓은 온도범위에서 장수명 사이클 성능을 보였다.
